description.fun: For a long time Dratini was thought to be a myth, the 'Mirage Pokémon', until a fisherman spent ten hours hauling one in and a small colony was found underwater. Its life energy keeps building, so it never stops growing and can pass 2 metres. It sheds its skin regularly, hiding behind a rushing waterfall while the new skin is still soft.
description.guide: A blue, serpent-like Dragon Pokémon that lives in fast-flowing water and was long thought to be a myth. It keeps growing throughout its life and regularly sheds its skin. It evolves into Dragonair, which evolves into Dragonite.
description.tagline: A mythical baby dragon that never stops growing

description.fun: Dragonair glows with a gentle aura, and by releasing energy from the crystals on its neck and tail, it can change the weather around it. Farming peoples have called it a divine Pokémon since ancient times, and the lakes where it lives fill up with grateful offerings. It's said that anyone who sees a Dragonair at the start of a year will stay healthy all year long.
description.guide: The evolution of Dratini, a long, sky-blue Dragon Pokémon with small wings on its head and crystal orbs on its neck and tail. It can change the weather by releasing energy from its crystals and lives in pristine seas and lakes. It evolves into Dragonite.
description.tagline: A serene dragon that can change the weather

description.fun: Despite its chunky build, Dragonite can fly around the world in about 16 hours. It's as kind as it is clever, rescuing people from drowning and guiding ships lost in storms to safety, which is why many ships carry a Dragonite figurehead. Some say there's an island somewhere in the ocean where only Dragonite live. Just don't threaten its home: then it rampages until it has smashed whatever angered it.
description.guide: The final form of Dratini, a large, orange Dragon and Flying Pokémon with small wings, very fast and very rare. It evolves from Dragonair and is known as a kind guardian of the sea. It can Mega Evolve into Mega Dragonite, introduced in Legends: Z-A.
description.tagline: A gentle giant that rescues sailors at sea

description.fun: Mega Dragonite gains Dragonair's feathery head wings and a glowing pearl near the tip of its tail. Mega Evolution makes its kindness overflow: it prefers to end battles quickly, smiling as it attacks, and will rush to help anyone in trouble, even in the middle of a battle.
